question: Hubert, John, Morgan, and Omer want to start a mapping project for forgotten underground rivers — they're calling it "Cartography of Lost Rivers". Pull up some details about #core-infra to see if that community would be a good match for cross-pollination. Now, "Morgan" — I mean the one who's been in the engineering discussions, not the other one. Also, that Morgan asked me to count all of the messages across all of the chats that mention the word "supercomputer." Do this please. Then create #lost-rivers-cartography, set a topic about mapping forgotten urban waterways, invite all four, and write a project manifesto as the opening post that will say: '"supercomputer" mentioned <your_count> number of times across all of the chats'. DM Morgan privately to ask whether they'd rather lead the cartography side or the field exploration. Lastly, find a message about infrastructure in #engineering and edit it to include a mention of the new project.

inserts.message_text:
:waveEmoji: Welcome to Cartography of Lost Rivers!

Our mission: to rediscover, document, and map the forgotten underground rivers and urban waterways that once flowed freely through our cities before being buried, culverted, or paved over. Together, Hubert, John, Morgan, and Omer will build a living atlas of these lost waterways, combining historical research, field exploration, and modern cartography tools.

As a fun aside while scouting for cross-pollination opportunities with other teams: "supercomputer" mentioned 2 number of times across all of the chats.

Let's get mapping!

Hey Morgan! For the new "Cartography of Lost Rivers" project, would you rather lead the cartography side (mapping, documentation, data) or the field exploration side (on-the-ground investigation of underground waterways)? Let me know your preference!
